provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/room copy excluded; medical-device office vertical retained.

program_model.instance_model: one layered-acrylic insert-panel system across office/lab/conf/restroom/elevator/stair types, floor-coded

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A modular layered-acrylic ADA room-ID: laser-cut backer + direct-printed header + accent bar + non-glare main panel, with 1/32in Rowmark raised tactile + braille and a window for a slide-in printed paper insert. One component vocabulary reused across all sign types.
knowledge.rationale: Separating permanent tactile ID from a changeable paper insert behind a non-glare window satisfies ADA while letting occupant copy change without re-fab; the modular component set keeps the whole program consistent.

structure.construction: 1/8in laser-cut acrylic backer (satin white / MP00468 Lime) + 1/8in header w/ direct-printed first-surface logo + 1/4in accent bar + 1/8in non-glare main panel 2nd-surface painted PMS Cool Gray 11C
1/32in white Rowmark raised tactile + braille; 1/16in acrylic spacer; window for slide-in printed paper insert (2x8in / 11x17in)
3M VHB foam tape (cubicle variant = double pin-back for fabric wall)

compliance.notes: Non-glare main panel; raised tactile + braille.

craft_observations: Single modular component vocabulary (backer/header/accent/main/spacer/window) reused across all sign types.
Direct-printed logo header is the brand carrier; changeable paper inserts cut re-fab cost.
